description: This file is a unit test for the 'key' module in the 'core' subdirectory of the 'base' package, within the 'summernote' project. It tests functions to identify editing keys and movement keys in the context of summernote's key handling.

methods.name: isEdit
methods.description: Checks if a given key code corresponds to an editing key such as BACKSPACE or DELETE.

methods.name: isMove
methods.description: Checks if a given key code corresponds to a movement key such as LEFT.
